audit.whatIsWrong: The 2+ items row rendered two different answers: full-layer phases[6].side said Mordekaiser while content win[6] said Skill. The First item row also disagreed with the mirror, which has already flipped it to Mordekaiser.
audit.why: This is the exact two-layer split the regression check blocks on — a paying user sees one side in the chart and the other in the level list. The mirror is already committed to Mordekaiser at First item (3/10 from Garen's side), so leaving Skill here would be overwritten by mirror-fix.
audit.corrected: First item flipped to Mordekaiser in both layers (7/10 ours, the inverse of Garen's 3/10) and win[6] brought up to Mordekaiser to match phases[6].side. whys[5] and whys[6] rewritten so the reasons match the new sides.

audit.why: Spikes are already accurate and specific: Garen owns 1-2 on the silence and Courage, level 3 equalises on Q+W+Darkness Rise, level 6 is Realm of Death, first item is Liandry's. Only the framing of the first-item spike moved with the chart flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: Courage was described only as 'damage reduction on cast' with no cooldown and no mention of the shield and tenacity that come first. Decisive Strike's auto-attack reset was never stated, and Demacian Justice's true damage was mentioned only in passing as 'ignores my HP stacking'.
audit.why: Courage is 22/19.5/17/14.5/12 and Riot's text gives shield plus tenacity first, then a longer, weaker damage reduction — the tenacity is why the pre-R lockdown feels short. Decisive Strike is flagged autoReset, so the tell is the wind-up, not the cast. Demacian Justice is true damage, which makes resistances the wrong purchase against it.
audit.corrected: Cooldown and the shield/tenacity/damage-cut sequence written into dosFull[0].d; the auto-reset tell into dontsFull[0].d; the true-damage point into whys[6] and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Perseverance was described as 'regen heals my poke when he's untargeted', which reads as passive healing he gets for free.
audit.why: Riot's text conditions it on not having been struck by damage or enemy abilities recently — it is a disengage-and-reset heal, and staying on him with Darkness Rise stops it starting at all.
audit.corrected: Stated as a heal you deny by staying on him, written into whys[5].

edits.before: Back to even: Liandry's makes Darkness Rise grind through his Courage damage-cut, but his Perseverance heal and Demacian Justice execute spike just as hard, so the all-in is a wash.
edits.after: Mine on first item: Liandry's grinds Darkness Rise straight through the Courage damage-cut, and Perseverance only regenerates when he is left untouched — so stay on him and the heal never starts.

edits.before: Even late: I delete him if I land R, but his Perseverance regen heals my poke when he's untargeted and his true-damage missing-HP execute ignores my HP stacking while he splitpushes — neither of us takes over.
edits.after: Mine late: Realm of Death deletes him whenever I catch him alone, and stacked HP does nothing about Demacian Justice — it is true damage, so buy resistances for his team and just stay above the execute line.

edits.before: Damage reduction on cast. R him once it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Courage is 22s at rank 1 — shield and tenacity first, then damage cut. R after it.

edits.before: That is Garen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Decisive Strike is an auto reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to step out.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Courage cuts your burst for its whole duration — 140s of R for nothing.

notes: No suspect names in this packet and none found. The full/content split on the 2+ items row (Mordekaiser vs Skill) was live on disk and is the kind of defect the regression check now blocks — worth noting that it existed here even though the packet chart itself was clean, so a matching packet chart is not evidence the two layers agree. The Mordekaiser kit's derived 'grounding' flag on Q is not supported by Riot's Obliterate text; I wrote nothing claiming Obliterate stops Decisive Strike's move-speed break.
